articles.title: Philippines raises Mayon volcano alert following explosive eruption
articles.description: ASTANA - The Philippines has raised the alert level for Mayon volcano to Level 3 following a “moderately explosive” eruption on Friday, prompting authorities to call for the evacuation of residents living within a six-kilometer radius of the volcano, a wire service reported.
